rules.description: Every supplied pipeline artifact is canonical, known-version, schema-valid, hash-valid, uniquely identified, exact-source, and linked to the exact authoritative upstream revisions.
Goals, project scope, and non-goals are defined.
Actors, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, and business rules are defined.
Domains, major flows, integrations, and constraints are defined.
The independently verified unresolved P0/P1/P2 decision count is zero.
Every architecture question is resolved and linked to an ADR.
Required ADRs exist and are accepted and approved.
Dependencies, risks, and assumptions are recorded.
The authoritative epic-to-issue map is complete.
The latest exact-source Spec Audit equals a fresh independent audit and has status PASS.
Current analysis-state evidence is an exact-source verified AUDIT_PASSED transition to READY_FOR_ISSUES.
Unresolved P3/P4 assumptions remain visible without masking blocking failures.
